title: Tax Manager – Reporting & Technology
sourceText:
Requisition ID: 39940 


 

Cheers to creating an incredible tomorrow!
At Molson Coors, we tackle big challenges and defy the status quo.  With a proud legacy of excellence, an incredible portfolio of beer, seltzers, spirits, and non-alcohol brands, and a bold vision for our future... we’re on the path to transforming the beverage industry.  That requires remarkable individuals who are curious, tenacious, and never afraid to fail forward.

We seek, value and respect everyone’s unique perspectives and experiences knowing that we are stronger together.  We collaborate as a team and celebrate each other’s successes.

Here’s to crafting careers and creating new legacies.

Crafted Highlights:   
The Tax Manager – Reporting & Technology role, based in Milwaukee, WI, you'll play a key role in shaping how Molson Coors leverages technology to simplify complex tax processes, strengthen controls, and unlock new insights across our global tax function.

In this highly collaborative role, you will partner with stakeholders across Tax, Finance, and IT to drive the transformation of global tax processes through automation, analytics, AI, and other emerging technologies. You will help build a more scalable, insight-driven tax function by reducing manual processes, enhancing data quality, and enabling the team to focus on higher-value, strategic activities. In addition, you will ensure reliable operation, support, and continuous improvement of existing tax technology solutions.

This role includes direct people leadership responsibility and significant influence over global tax processes, systems, data, controls, and technology-enabled transformation priorities.

This role reports to the Sr. Director Global Tax Reporting.

What You’ll Be Brewing:

Own and lead the global tax technology strategy, roadmap, and operating model, ensuring tax technology capabilities effectively support tax compliance, reporting, planning, controls, workflow, analytics and business decision-making needs.
Drive enterprise-level tax transformation initiatives and innovation through automation, analytics, AI and emerging technologies, including hands-on use of AI-enabled tools, e.g., Claude and Copilot, and data platforms to build and maintain dashboards and self-service reporting. The goal is to improve efficiency, scalability, and decision-making across the tax function.
Set priorities, build business cases, define success measures, and align resources for tax technology initiatives, ensuring investments deliver measurable outcomes such as efficiency gains, risk reduction, faster cycle times, improved controls, and enhanced decision-making.
Partner with senior stakeholders across Tax, Finance, IT, Enterprise Data, Internal Controls and external vendors to manage dependencies, influence and align priorities, resolve issues, and deliver sustainable technology solutions across the global tax function.
Lead adoption and change management by raising the level of technology capabilities across the Tax team through training, championing new ways of working, and driving adoption of technology solutions.
Monitor emerging technologies and industry-leading practices and identify opportunities to further simplify tax processes, improve data quality, and enhance the effectiveness of the Tax organization.
Ensure a strong tax technology control environment by establishing and maintaining disciplined data, process, and access governance, mitigating risk while supporting efficient and reliable tax operations.
 

Key Ingredients:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in corporate tax, tax technology, or tax process improvements within a multinational corporation or public accounting firm.
Demonstrated experience with tax technology platforms such as Corptax, ONESOURCE, or similar tax compliance and provision solutions.
Strong understanding of multinational tax compliance and tax reporting processes.
Demonstrated experience leading technology, automation, or process improvement initiatives.
Experience with analytics and productivity applications, such as Power BI, Power Query, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or comparable tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions and influence stakeholders across functions.
Experience developing and coaching team members while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Preferred qualifications include in-depth knowledge of tax issues affecting global multinational businesses, in-depth, administrator level knowledge of Corptax or ONESOURCE, and experience with ERP platforms such as SAP.

Beverage Bonuses:  

Flexible work programs that support work life balance including a hybrid work model of 4 days in the office
Participation in our Total Rewards program with a competitive base salary, incentive plans, parental leave, health, dental, vision, retirement plan options with incredible employer match, generous paid time off plans, an engaging Wellness Program, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with amazing resources
On site Pub, access to cool brand clothing and swag, top events and, of course... free beer and beverages! 
We care about our People and Planet and have challenged ourselves with stretch goals around our key priorities  
We care about our communities, and play our part to make a difference – from charitable donations to hitting the streets together to build parks, giving back to the community is part of our culture and who we are 
Engagement with a variety of Business Resource Groups, which can provide volunteer opportunities, leadership experience, and networking through the organization 
Ability to grow and develop your career centered around our First Choice Learning opportunities
Work within a fast paced and innovative company, meeting passionate colleagues and partners with diverse backgrounds and experiences 
 


Molson Coors is an equal opportunity employer.  We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruitment processes, please e-mail jobs@molsoncoors.com. 


Pay and Benefits:

At Molson Coors, we’re committed to paying people fairly and equitably for the work they do.


Job Posting Total Rewards Offerings: $109,100.00 - $143,200.00 (posting salary range) + 15% target short term incentive + $23,000 on average spent on benefits per employee, including but not limited to health, dental, vision, retirement with above market employer match, wellness incentives and EAP + paid time off (including holidays, vacation days and sick days).


The posting range provided above for salary is what we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We ultimately pay based on a number of non-discriminatory factors that inform pay decisions including but not limited to the required work location, previous work experience, skill set and internal equity.
